newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway says Statoil value seen at 110-126 bln NOK.
newsitem.headline: Norway says Statoil value seen at 110-126 bln NOK.

text.p: Norway's Oil and Energy Ministry said on Friday two independent estimates upgraded state-owned petroleum group Den norske stats oljeselskap AS's (Statoil) value to 110-126 billion crowns from 80-90 billion a year earlier.

The new evaluations were made by Union Bank of Switzerland and Den norske Bank (DnB) Markets. Investment bank Goldman Sachs and Norwegian brokerage FIBA carried out valuations from 1993 to 1996, the ministry said in a statement.
"Statoil is in an active investment phase which in the long term will give the group an increased value," Oil and Energy Minister Ranveig Froeiland said.
